requirements.label: Juris Doctor pathway · school-leaver rank and equivalence
requirements.details: The 2027 international guide lists ATAR 96 or IB 37 for the standard undergraduate pathway. UWA’s overseas table maps GCE A levels to 14 aggregate points at ATAR 96 (for example AAB). The published Advanced Placement table does not specify the ATAR 96 conversion.
